Nothing new has landed on it since yesterday, Eric, and I won't pretend otherwise.

What I can tell you is more exact now: the parcel that reached you in July held the NerdOctaxe, a GekkoAxe GT and a NerdQaxe++. Your NerdQX never physically went out, even though the order reads fulfilled, so there's no second parcel to track. I've put that in front of Abel and Georges with the detail, and they're on right now.

Stay in this window if you can. Otherwise it comes to (email hidden)
Any new information on my order

Same minute, Eric, so nothing has changed since my last line. The team has it open now.

While they do, there's a choice you can make and I'll act on it here: I can put the $226.82 for that NerdQX back as store credit on your account, or move it onto something we actually have on the shelf, like the NerdOctaxe at $359.99 or the Hammer BC04 at $239, so a box ships this week instead of you waiting on a booking.

Which way do you want it?
